package.name: cobot_tasks
package.description: Task manager — owns WHAT the system is doing. Runs the state machine (idle / scanning / picking / calibrating), sequences work by sending action goals to cobot_node and service calls to the vision nodes, and publishes the single source of operational truth on /task/status. Dependency rule: rclpy + cobot_interfaces ONLY — this node never computes geometry and never touches motoman/camera code.
